name: Extension Sandbox Cells
description: Extensions run in sandbox cells with capability-scoped handles. No ambient authority: every resource access must go through an explicitly granted capability handle. Sandbox cells have resource limits.
purpose: Eliminate ambient authority for extensions by running them in sandbox cells where every resource access requires an explicitly granted, capability-scoped handle.
acceptanceCriteria: Every extension runs in its own sandbox cell
Sandbox cells have no ambient authority (no implicit filesystem, network, or process access)
All resource access goes through capability-scoped handles
Sandbox cells have resource limits (CPU, memory, storage) configurable per extension
Sandbox escape attempts produce security event receipts
Sandbox cells are isolated from each other (no cross-extension communication without broker)
